contexts.text: That the length = the holiness of these things... cannot be so well confirmed from the Word, because everything is predicated according to the subject treated of; as, for instance, length, in application to time, = what is perpetual and eternal; as length of days; but in application to space, it = what is holy...
As a tall man. AC 1126. SE 4072.
According to its length, and according to its breadth () = what is celestial and spiritual; or, what is the same, good and truth.
The Celestial, or good, being primary, is compared to length; and the Spiritual, or truth, being secondary, is compared to breadth. Illustrated.
For length, and the things which are of length, are predicated of good.

(Therefore) lengths, breadths, and heights, which are measurements of space, = such things as are of state; length = what is holy; height, what is good; and breadth, what is true. References. AC 4482:end.
That length is said of good. References.
Two cubits and a half its length () = all as to good.
That length, in the Word, = good; and breadth, truth. Explained.
The measuring of the New Jerusalem as to length = the quality of good; and as to breadth, the quality of truth.
Two cubits its length () = all as to conjunction with good.
The length of one curtain eight and twenty in cubit () = what is holy of truth from good. Length = good.
The length of one curtain thirty in cubit () = what is full of truth from good. Length = good.
Ten cubits the length of a board () = that this good is all in all... Length = good; here, the supporting good, which is the good of merit...
Five cubits the length, and five cubits the breadth () = equally from good and from truth.
A hundred in cubit the length () = full with good from the Lord. Explained.
The length of the court a hundred in cubit () = the good of that Heaven to the full.
The reason length = good, is that these things are reckoned from the east to the west; and by the east and west is signified good from one terminus to the other.
Under Degree, see this reference.
Times seem long to those who are sad... AE 1219:4.

I will state what is signified in the Word by length, breadth, and height. In the world, that is called long and broad which is long and broad as to space; in like manner what is high; but in Heaven, where they do not think from space, by length is meant a state of good; by breadth, a state of truth; and by height, the differences in them according to degrees... because long, in Heaven, is from east to west; and there are those who are in the good of love: and broad, in Heaven, is from south to north; and there are those who are in truth from good: and high, in Heaven, is both according to degrees. Hence it is, that in the Word, by length, breadth, and height, such things are signified. Illustrated. AR 861:2.
The length of the New Jerusalem = its good of love; its breadth, the truth from that good; and its height, the good and truth as to degrees.
Length = good and its extension; and breadth = truth and its extension. References.
In all the objects of (natural) sight there is figure derived from what is long, broad, and high...

But the thought of an Angel has nothing in common with the figure... which derives anything from what Is long, broad, and high of space; but from the state of a thing from the state of the life. Hence, instead of what is long of space, he thinks of the good of a thing from the good of life; instead of what is broad of space, of the truth of a thing from the truth of life; and instead of height, of the degrees of these. Thus he thinks from correspondence... from which correspondence it is that length, in the Word, = the good of a thing; breadth, the truth of a thing; and height, the degrees of these.

Its length is as great as its breadth () = that the good and truth in that Church make one, as do essence and form. By the length of the city Jerusalem, is signified the good of the Church; and by its breadth is signified the truth of the Church. Explained.

The length, and the breadth, and the height of it were equal () = that all things of it were from the good of love... For by length is signified the good of love... and this precedes, the others being equal to it.
Long = extension.
Length = the good of the Church.
Length = its good of love.
They are called men of length () from good; for length = good and its quality.
